title: Karti Hai Bain Aaliya
body:
karti hain bain Alia ae zamin chadar
mein ho gayi hon be rida ae zamin chadar
aa dekh khul gaye hain nabi zaadiyoun ke sir
hanstay hain hum pay ashkiya ae zamin chadar
maqtal mein milnay aaye hain mujh se mere baba
aur sir hai burhenapa mera ae zamin chadar
balon se mun chhupa ke har ik bibi tarap kar
deti rahen bas ik sada ae zamin chadar
nazrain jami hui hain sitam garon ki hum par
ik baar to nazrain utha ae zamin chadar
Ghayoor mere mujh ko bataday sire naiza
kyun rukta nahi sir tera ae zamin chadar
chehray ko sakeena ke tamacho ne chupaya
kis terha tu pehchane ga ae zamin chadar
ik naizay pay sir bhai ka ik par meri chadar
manzar yeh bhula payi na ae zamin chadar
bas kar ke yaad ranj o alum shaam ke har pal
sajjad khoo rota raha ae zamin chadar
Us dam Jawad mera jigar phatt gaya gham se
jis waqt yeh noha likha ae zamin chadar
